player_prompt.intro: Siyakwamukela ku-Lights Out! Unegridi yezibani engu- {size}x{size}. Umgomo wakho ukucisha ZONKE izibani (ezibonakaliswa ngu-'.') Uma ucindezela isibani, siyazijika kanye nomakhelwane baso (phezulu / phansi / kwesobunxele / kwesokudla). Thayipha [row col] ukuze ucindezele isibani (esinenkomba engu- 0, ngakho uhla olusemthethweni ngu- 0-{max_index}). Unokuhamba okufika ku- {max_turns} ukuxazulula iphazili. Inganekwane: 'O' = ukukhanya ON, '.' = ukukhanya OFF

board.current_state: Isimo samanje segridi (Hambisa {moves_made}, {moves_left} uhamba okusele, {completion}% kuqediwe): {grid}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Isenzo kufanele sibe ngefomethi [row col] lapho umugqa no-col kuyizinombolo eziphelele kusuka ku-0 kuya ku{max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Coordinates must be between 0 and {max_index}. You entered [{row},{col}].

outcome.loss: Umdlalo uphelile! Usebenzise zonke {max_turns} izinyathelo ngaphandle kokuxazulula iphazili. Ukuqedela kokugcina: {completion}% Isimo sokugcina: {grid}
